188:t_10:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「I've got a pretty good idea what you're after. Anytime you're ready.」

188:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here I go! Putting my all into it again today...!」

188:t_10:57.en:
$$タケル$$
「This is what you wanted, right?」

188:t_10:58.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! I have most certainly received your full power, $$タケル$$!」

188:t_10:59.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, $$タケル$$... The time will surely come when $n's growth and your destiny overlap...)

189:t_000:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch... what the hell is this...」

189:t_000:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Raw bloodlust... And a bottomless darkness, as if it could drag my consciousness away...」

189:t_001:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...I leave it to you, $$尸刻$$.」

189:t_001:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「So you finally showed up, assassin!」

189:t_001:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「If we kept fighting the Empire, I figured he'd show up sooner or later...!」

189:t_001:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「Good opportunity! We'll break through you and go down to Earth!」

189:t_001:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I see... It is only natural that $$尸空#pilot$$ takes an interest in you.」

189:t_001:8.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Still the same cool beauty... No, not quite.」

189:t_001:9.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah... You could say she's like a woman in mourning clothes. Her sex appeal is to die for, but she doesn't make me want to lay a hand on her.」

189:t_001:10.en:
$$クラン$$
「Even at a time like this, those Snipe-Ups...!」

189:t_001:11.en:
$$マオ$$
「But in their own way, they seem to sense how dangerous that woman $$尸刻$$ is.」

189:t_001:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do you mean, that man is interested in us?」

189:t_001:13.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Even among the people of Earth, you are especially full of the power of life.」

189:t_001:14.en:
$$尸刻$$
「That is what lies farthest from us, the people of $$鬼宿$$...」

189:t_001:16.en:
$$シュレード$$
「So that's what it is.」

189:t_001:18.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I didn't come back from the brink of death for nothing.」

189:t_001:19.en:
$$シュレード$$
「That woman and her comrades... and the aura that $$尸空#pilot$$ wears... That is the power of life... You could say it's the exact opposite of the vitality and emotions of living people.」

189:t_001:20.en:
$$シュレード$$
「That doesn't mean they themselves are dead men. They are probably people who place themselves on the side of human death.」

189:t_001:22.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Exactly. That description fits perfectly.」

189:t_001:24.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$スフィア$$ of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$...」

189:t_001:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「To think a creepy guy like that is the $$新地球皇国$$'s $$スフィア・リアクター$$...!」

189:t_001:26.en:
$$勝平$$
「Just like that scorpion jerk from before, the Empire's Reactors are all a bunch of gloomy guys!」

189:t_001:28.en:
$$ランド$$
「Knock it off, $$ガロード$$, $$勝平$$.」

189:t_001:29.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That man's silence... his emptiness won't be shaken in the least by words like that.」

189:t_001:30.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hmm...! Hearing that just fires me up even more!」

189:t_001:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Taking down an out-and-out villain like that with a burning heart! That is exactly the role of a champion of justice!」

189:t_001:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$! $$ノノ$$, an android, is way more human than you are!」

189:t_001:36.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Yes. I will deploy all units.」

189:t_002:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「He isn't even listening to us...!?」

189:t_002:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Neither insults nor provocation reach that man...!」

189:t_002:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「He is like a dark, bottomless pit.」

189:t_002:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then we overpower him with force.」

189:t_002:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since words don't get through to him, it can't be helped.」

189:t_002:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, don't forget that this position is close to the upper atmosphere!」

189:t_002:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We still have atmospheric entry after this! Assume the operation's time limit is 8 minutes!」

189:t_002:8.en:
$n
「I'll take him down in those 8 minutes!」

189:t_002:9.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The $$悲しみの乙女$$, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$... and the $$いがみ合う双子$$...」

189:t_003:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「$$沈黙の巨蟹$$...! That emptiness... truly fearsome!」

189:t_003:3.en:
$n
「Damn! We're the same kind of Reactor, and I still can't beat him!」

189:t_003:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But I will never cooperate with you! Not now, and not ever!」

189:t_003:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What do you mean by that!? Are you saying $n hasn't mastered the $$スフィア$$!?」

189:t_003:17.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That is to be expected. It is that kind of $$スフィア$$.」

189:t_003:18.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It would be cruel to demand of you what even $$ガドライト#pilot$$ could not do.」

189:t_003:19.en:
$n
「I defeated him and got the $$スフィア$$...! I'll surpass that man!」

kept_omissions: 188:t_10:54: Takeru's 'I've got a good idea what you're after' - object not stated in the Japanese; taken as AG's 'one more favor' from 188:t_10:53
189:t_000:2: Clouseau's 'my consciousness' - the Japanese has no possessor
189:t_003:0: Shikuu 'Not enough.' kept without subject (nothing for it to be about beyond the fight)
189:t_003:14: Shikuu 'You are inert.' - addressed to the protagonist (next row is the protagonist's reaction and Suzune's protest)
uncertain: 188:t_10:54-56: scene is AG collecting Takeru's 'full power' (the favor from 188:t_10:53); 56 '商売、商売！' is Takeru's line (speaker Takeru in brief), read as a resigned 'Business is business!'

189:t_001:19 Shrade: 'あれは生命の力…言うなれば、生きている人間の活気や感情とは真逆のもの' is read literally (the aura is 'the power of life', i.e. the exact opposite of living people's vitality); the Japanese seems to play on Shikoku's 生命の力 and I kept the contradiction rather than smoothing it.
189:t_001:32 C.C. 冥府の門番: number unsettled, 'Gatekeepers of the underworld' used (covers Shikuu and Shikoku).
189:t_001:8-9: Michel/Kurz 'cool beauty' / mourning-clothes woman refers to Shikoku (the following rows settle it).
189:t_003:14/15: 無為 rendered 'inert' (also possible: idle, doing-nothing, futile); Shikuu means the protagonist has not drawn out the Sphere.
189:t_003:19: 'I defeated him' = Gadlight (glossary male); 'that man' = Shikuu (following 無駄だ).
189:t_003:3/ t_001:25: 皇国 = 'the Empire', 新地球皇国 via token; サソリ野郎 = Barbiel, 'scorpion jerk'.
189:t_001:26-27 Kappei: リアクター plain 'Reactors' (no token, per dlg_2010_xx habit).
189:t_001:10: スナンパーズ = 'Snipe-Ups' (as in dlg_51 slice).
189:t_001:35: そろそろいいだろう rendered 'I think it's time.' (signal to deploy, per Shikoku's reply).
Shikuu speaker line uses $$尸空#pilot$$ throughout (male pilot), as in earlier slices.
